question:
In the figure, chords XY = x cm and PQ = 10 cm are intersecting each other at point L. Find the length of XY (in cm).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa4eb51458f4947175a641e1ffeb389ec6e92862cc53054d17529cef6670e5c2.png]
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa4eb51458f4947175a641e1ffeb389ec6e92862cc53054d17529cef6670e5c2.png] 

XY = x cm and PQ = 10 cm

**Concept Used:**

When two chords of a circle intersect externally then,

LP × LQ = LX × LY

**Calculation:**

LP = (10 + 6) = 16 cm and, LQ = 6 cm

LX = (x + 4) cm and LY = 4 cm

According to the formula,

⇒ 16 × 6 = (x + 4) × 4

⇒ x = 20 cm

**∴ The length of XY is 20 cm.**
